<?php

require_once __DIR__ . "/vendor/autoload.php";

use App\Models\Task;
use App\Services\TaskService;

$service = new TaskService();

echo "=== Task Manager CLI ===\n";
echo "Perintah: add, list, done, delete, quit\n\n";

while (true) {
    echo "> ";
    $input = trim(fgets(STDIN));
    $parts = explode(" ", $input, 2);
    $cmd = $parts[0];
    $arg = $parts[1] ?? "";

    match ($cmd) {
        "add" => $service->add($arg),
        "list" => $service->list(),
        "done" => $service->complete((int) $arg),
        "delete" => $service->remove((int) $arg),
        "quit" => exit("Selesai.\n"),
        default => echo "Perintah tidak dikenal: $cmd\n",
    };
}

<?php

namespace App\Models;

class Task
{
    private static int $nextId = 1;

    public function __construct(
        public readonly int $id,
        public string $judul,
        public bool $selesai = false,
    ) {
        $this->id = $nextId++;
    }
}

<?php

namespace App\Services;

use App\Models\Task;

class TaskService
{
    /** @var Task[] */
    private array $tasks = [];

    public function add(string $judul): void
    {
        $this->tasks[] = new Task($judul);
        echo "Ditambah: $judul\n";
    }

    public function list(): void
    {
        if (empty($this->tasks)) {
            echo "Belum ada tugas.\n";
            return;
        }

        foreach ($this->tasks as $t) {
            $status = $t->selesai ? "✓" : "○";
            echo "{$status} [{$t->id}] {$t->judul}\n";
        }
    }

    public function complete(int $id): void
    {
        foreach ($this->tasks as $t) {
            if ($t->id === $id) {
                $t->selesai = true;
                echo "Selesai: {$t->judul}\n";
                return;
            }
        }
        echo "Tugas #$id tidak ditemukan.\n";
    }

    public function remove(int $id): void
    {
        foreach ($this->tasks as $i => $t) {
            if ($t->id === $id) {
                unset($this->tasks[$i]);
                $this->tasks = array_values($this->tasks);
                echo "Dihapus: #$id\n";
                return;
            }
        }
        echo "Tugas #$id tidak ditemukan.\n";
    }
}
README.md:
# PHP Lesson 16 - Final Project: Task Manager CLI

Jalankan: composer install && npm run dev
Coba: http://localhost:3000 (atau jalankan di terminal)

Fitur:
- add "Tugas baru" — tambah tugas
- list — tampilkan semua tugas
- done [id] — tandai selesai
- delete [id] — hapus tugas
- quit — keluar

Konsep yang dipakai: OOP (class Task, class TaskService), namespace, autoloading, match expression, array manipulation, CLI input (fgets/STDIN).
